name: RentalApplicationWizard
tagline: Rental applications from first enquiry to approval – in one drop-in Power Platform app.
description: A complete residential leasing app for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: dashboard, applications list, pipeline board, applicant detail with screening criteria (income-to-rent, guarantor rule, documents, rental history, fee and consent) and a 7-step application wizard. Works instantly with demo data, then binds to any table or collection with simple column mappings.
features: Fee and consent gate before submit
Allowed status transitions with conditional approval and decline reasons
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
Custom labels, statuses, currency and accent colour
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: RentalApplicationWizard data-set, RentalApplicationWizardPortal field)
